title: onvif-tt parsed ONVIF Test Specification corpus
description: Generated by `onvif-tt corpus refresh` from corpus/html/*.html. A flat array of TestCase records, one per `<section id="tc.*">` in the spec HTML.

version.description: Spec version stamp from the section's `version` attribute (e.g. "16.07"). May be null.

profile_area.description: File stem of the source HTML (BASE, MEDIA2, PTZ, EVENT, IMAGING, RTSS, …).

spec_file.description: Source filename inside corpus/html/, e.g. BASE.html.

title.description: Human-readable title taken from the section's `<title>` element.

labels.description: Key-value pairs from the `<para>` block at the head of the section (Test Case ID, Specification Coverage, Feature Under Test, WSDL Reference, Test Purpose, Pre-Requisite, Test Configuration, Test Result).

fail_criteria.description: Text extracted from the `FAIL – …` paragraph(s), concatenated.

step_id.description: Addressable DocBook step id (e.g. `tc.IPCONFIG-1-1-3.7.1`). Null on synthesised top-level steps.

text.description: Step body text, whitespace-normalised, with nested ordered/unordered lists removed (they become sub_steps).

operations.description: ONVIF operation names referenced in this step (CamelCase bold-emphasis tokens in the spec).

variables.description: Italic-emphasis variable names used in this step (e.g. `networkInterfacesList1`).

sub_steps.description: Recursive nested steps from inner ordered-list elements.
